projects.name: Smart Air Quality Monitoring System Using Home Assistant | Smart Air Measurer
bullets: Designed and programmed a Raspberry Pi Pico-based IoT device to measure PM2.5 particulate matter, temperature, humidity, and carbon monoxide levels.
Integrated the monitoring system with Home Assistant to visualize environmental data and enable automated control of electrical appliances in response to air quality conditions.
Developed real-time air quality notifications using LINE Notify. The system underwent practical testing and achieved a high user satisfaction rating for ease of use, with an average score of 4.25.
